description: Lists the upcoming fixtures on tactica.'s current forecast list for the English Premier League (EPL), EFL Championship, EFL League 1 & EFL League 2: fixtureId, kick-off time (ISO 8601), league, home team and away team, earliest kick-off first; freeSample marks the Match of the Round, whose forecast is free. Use this when you need a fixtureId, which every per-match tool requires; call it first. It has no forecasts or picks: use get_match_forecast, get_case_file or get_betting_picks instead for those. Free, no payment. Read-only; the current list at call time. No parameters.
name: list_fixtures
title: List upcoming fixtures
